{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Ensure only completed orders are used
completed_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for balance between channels in terms of customer_segment and customer_age
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation (channel vs customer_segment):")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_df['channel'], completed_df['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (grouped into bins)
completed_df['age_group'] = pd.cut(completed_df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 25, 35, 50, 100], labels=['<25', '25-35', '35-50', '50+'])
print("\nCross-tabulation (channel vs age_group):")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_df['channel'], completed_df['age_group']))

# Check if channels are balanced
# Compute proportions
email_prop = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0] / completed_df.shape[0]
paid_search_prop = completed_df[completed_df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0] / completed_df.shape[0]

print(f"\nProportion of email: {email_prop:.4f}")
print(f"Proportion of paid_search: {paid_search_prop:.4f}")

# Check if the difference is confounded by customer segment or age
# Compute conversion rates within each segment
seg_conv = completed_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nConversion rates by channel and customer_segment:")
print(seg_conv)

# Compute conversion rates within age groups
age_conv = completed_df.groupby(['channel', 'age_group'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nConversion rates by channel and age_group:")
print(age_conv)"}
